name: Mutiara Line (Island Corridor)
summary: Runs north–south along the eastern corridor of Penang Island from Silicon Island through Penang International Airport, Bayan Lepas FIZ, USM/Sungai Dua, and Jelutong to Komtar in George Town.

name: Cross-Channel Alignment (Macallum – Penang Sentral)
summary: Branches east from Macallum across the Penang Strait (with 62m navigational clearance) to Penang Sentral in Butterworth for direct interchange with KTMB ETS, Komuter Utara, and Rapid Ferry.
